name: Geometry
description: 2D affine Matrix, the Transform (position, scale, rotation; scene space is y down) layers and instances use, axis-aligned Rect, vector Paths with line, quadratic and cubic segments and their affine transform, tight shape bounds, and point hit testing (even-odd and nonzero fill, strokes, through instances). The per-frame render list of a scene or symbol: one walk that gives the layer and instance tree exporters write and the flat paint-order items (matrix, multiplied opacity, inherited lock, address) the stage draws, each with its clips (its layer's and host layers' masks in scene space, in order, with mode, feather, opacity and inversion) and its track matte (the source's items and the matte kind, a hidden source listed only as a matte item, the source flagged); the queries over it (topmost hit with a tolerance, marquee, world bounds with stroke); and the path builders for rectangles, ellipses, polygons and stars. The path ops in PathOps/: an anchors view (corner, smooth and symmetric points with handles) that round-trips to Path; nearest point, insert, remove and convert an anchor; arc length, the point and tangent at a length, trim and dash; a stroke outlined into a fillable path for every join and cap; and union, subtract, intersect and exclude under either fill rule, refusing input past a vertex cap with tooComplex. Nothing here traps on non-finite input.
